frames.headline: Write the math. See the answer.
frames.subline: Keep your notes and calculations on the same sheet.
frames.typedContent:
# Project estimate
rate = 85
hours = 12
subtotal = rate * hours
tax = 20% of subtotal
subtotal + tax
frames.captureNotes: Calculator; new sheet via Command-N. Precision 2, digit grouping on. Resize actual panel to about 1280x600 points on a 2x display. Show all lines and full result column; no selection or menus. Final result 1 224.00.

frames.captureNotes: New sheet. Keep whole panel and result column visible. Expected numeric values at precision 2: 16.09, 5.51, 120.00, 204.00, with units as rendered by the app.

frames.headline: Your weather briefing in one line.
frames.subline: Weather reports and conversions for study and reference.
frames.typedContent:
METAR KSFO
120 kt in km/h
29.92 inHg in hPa
frames.captureNotes: Use Calculator, not a fabricated cockpit view. Wait for a real KSFO report; show station, complete report and freshness indicator. The conversions remain 222.24 km / h and 1 013.21 hPa at precision 2. Do not imply flight planning certification. If the complete report does not fit legibly, remove the METAR line, change headline to 'Aviation conversions, in one place.' and subline to 'Speed and pressure conversions for study and reference.' Update this manifest before rendering. Do not crop away stale/error status or type a fake METAR.

frames.headline: Compare currencies in one place.

frames.typedContent:
# Travel money
100 EUR in USD
1500 THB in EUR
0.01 BTC in USD
frames.captureNotes: Internet connected. Wait for genuine fiat and crypto rates to arrive. Show actual outputs and rate-source annotation. Inspect the source annotation and sanity-check the conversion outputs before capture. Settings has no live-rate status panel. Never use cold-start 1:1 fallback outputs, fixtures or manually replaced numbers. Source annotation uses smaller app text than sourceTextSizePx; inspect it in the finished frame separately.

frames.headline: Change a number. Rethink the plan.
frames.subline: Variables keep the related calculations up to date.
frames.typedContent:
# Weekend budget
guests = 6
dinner = 180
ride = 36
(dinner + ride) / guests
frames.captureNotes: Final still uses six guests and result 36.00. For the video, begin with guests = 4 (result 54.00), then replace only 4 with 6. Do not add an equals sign or result to the input.
